DOGS.counterplay: Fire, Burn, Bleed, and Slow punish the pack. Their speed helps them avoid heavy Siege.

CELTS.counterplay: Their close-order toughness resists Melee and control. Ranged volleys and Siege break the formation.

CARTHAGE.counterplay: Disciplined armor resists physical attacks and lingering effects. Siege is the clean formation breaker.

UNDEAD_CELTS.counterplay: Poison and Bleed cannot harm the dead. Fire, Burn, and Divine judgment are their faction counters.

UNDEAD_CARTHAGE.counterplay: Bone armor resists Melee and control while ignoring Poison and Bleed. Fire, Burn, and Divine damage crack the legion.

SUPER_DEMONS.counterplay: Fire and Burn are useless. Divine punishment is strongest, while Poison and Bleed remain effective alternatives.

MONGOLS.counterplay: Mobile discipline resists physical chip, Slow, Bleed, and Poison. Siege disrupts their fast formations.

EGYPTIANS.counterplay: Tomb wards resist Ranged attacks, Fire, Burn, and Poison. Divine damage breaks their ritual protection.

ROMAN_MYTH.counterplay: Mythic bodies resist steel, Siege, Fire, and most status pressure. Divine answers most of them, but Colossus Gigas is the Siege exception: it takes 3x Siege damage and resists 80% of Divine.

OCEAN.counterplay: Waterlogged bodies resist Fire, Burn, and status attrition. Siege and Divine damage break their tide armor.

NEUTRAL.counterplay: Neutral controls take unmodified direct damage so testing remains accurate.
